newsitem.title: UK: Ofwat says to expect price cuts at next review.
newsitem.headline: Ofwat says to expect price cuts at next review.

text.p: Britain's water industry regulator Ofwat said on Wednesday that customers should expect a reduction in prices at the next periodic review which will be completed in December 1999.

"At the next review I will expect companies to demonstrate improving standards for their customers and efficiency gains will allow prices to come down in real terms, despite continuing capital investment requirements," said Ofwat head Ian Byatt.
Byatt has written to water companies setting out his proposed objectives, timetable and the key issues for the next periodic review.

Ofwat said in a statement that one of its main objectives in the review will be that savings made by water companies in reducing their costs since the last price review in 1994 should be transferred quickly to customers.
Ofwat also said it was considering appointing senior industrialists to offer Byatt strategic advice about conducting the periodic review.
